i have far more planned for this level but a lot of that will happen when level 2 is ready so for now this is just a quick patch to get things working again

Initial upload

- Added new text in Musics tab in Credits Terminal
- Fixed the tagging of some Doors
- Fixed the tagging on some stairs so now Guttermen explode in them instead of just existing

- Updated to Ultra_Revamp compatibility (Holy shit this took a LOT of time and work)
- Added new Copyright-Claim-Free music composed by WOOSP (Original music can still be played via toggling the record player in the start room)
- Added Demo for M-2 (Don't expect it anytime soon - it'll be done when it's done)
- Slightly reduced encounter difficulty in every major arena (As a standalone map the difficulty was fine, but as level 1 of a set of 4 it was too much)
- Removed first cooldown encounter (It was really lame and didn't add anything to the level)
- Improved performance throughout the level (If it's still laggy, just know it used to be much MUCH worse)
- Removed a tiny bit of eye-candy in places you won't notice (It caused even more lag post Ultra_Revamp update)
- Added a tiny bit of eye-candy in places you won't notice (Not enough to drop FPS, but enough to fill in some blank spots)
- Fixed secret cat number 3 not being properly illuminated (Meow!)
- Made mandatory progression vent cover ajar to better indicate that it can be accessed early (Almost nobody noticed this lmao)
- Changed location of busted vent cover after blue skull pickup to better indicate to the player where to go (It's not supposed to be that complicated)
- Simplified lighting in final arena (You won't notice any difference)
- Oil spill is no longer spilled oil but instead spilled slippery orange kool-aid (It being oil was hacky and no longer works right post Ultra_Revamp update)
- Rebalanced light level in intro (Less dark in some places to make it feel more dark in other places)
- Improved chains model shown after blue skull pickup (2spoopy4u)
- Player can no longer softlock themselves in the 2nd arena secret room (No longer requires whiplash to exit)
- Secret cheese pickup now acts like soap because I got sufficient hate mail complaining about it (Yummy!)

- Added extra redundancy to final floor break logic in final arena (On rare occasions it would not break, will probably break every time now)
- Fixed bug where Mass death in final arena wouldn't trigger events properly
- Fixed blood splatters appearing on SpinNeedles
- Skull in cage in first arena arena now uses white salt altar
- Added Navblockers to second arena catwalk to encourage two strays to get killed via the environmental fire hazard ( +AIR FRIED)

M-1:
- Fixed credits names
- Fixed some gears in first arena hurting the player when in their "off" state
- Fixed some steam jet particles clipping through walls in a very obvious place
- Fixed burning pit in second arena not properly killing enemies (+OOF OUCH OWIE THAT'S 2 HOT 4 ME)
- Fixed spinning wall fans in second arena not always spinning on level load
- Added "Ping!" sound and effect to hookpoints when they spawn in or change - Thanks Bongwater!
- Made tiny rewrite to song revamped description

M-2 Demo:
- Added a demo-specific challenge
- Made second line of nixie-tube text a tiny bit more interesting by adding extra sparks and audio to its turning on sequence
- Lowered the frequency of idle sparks in dark computer room just a little bit
- Fixed computer startup sound replaying every time second room is unloaded and then reloaded
